title: PortXR catalogue entry
description: games/<slug>/meta.json: what a game needs to play well in VR with PortXR, and who tested it.

game.description: The game's name as its store page writes it.

slug.description: The folder name and the page address. Never changes once published.

engineVersion.description: As PortXR shows it on the game's page: 2021.3, 5.4, 4.3.

exe.description: The game's exe, which names its scripts folder. Unreal games: the <Game>-Win64-Shipping.exe.

author.description: GitHub name of whoever wrote the entry.

version.description: Version of this entry. Raise it with every change to its files.

status.description: works: playable start to end as far as tested. partial: playable with the problems in notes. broken: not playable yet.

display.description: The display mode this entry was tested in.

hasOnlineMultiplayer.description: The game has an online mode. The entry is still for single-player only.

hasAntiCheat.description: Games with anti-cheat are not accepted.

containsCode.description: True when any file is a Lua script.

notes.description: What works, what does not, what the files fix. Plain text.

sample.description: A made-up entry that shows the format. Removed before the catalogue opens.
